subject.title: [Feature]: Add native checkpoint engine with deterministic resume and diff

question: Should OpenClaw own a core native checkpoint/replay/diff contract, and what should the first version expose across Gateway protocol, persistence, replay safety, validation, and UI/CLI surfaces?
rationale: The request is useful but spans core protocol, durable state, replay semantics, security boundaries, UI/CLI shape, and overlapping session-state issues; automation cannot safely choose that product/API boundary.

options.title: Define core contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require a small design/API decision before implementation starts.

options.title: Move to plugin/API extension
options.body: If maintainers want plugin ownership, define only the missing checkpoint or context-engine extension API needed for an external plugin to implement it.

options.title: Reject broad native engine
options.body: Close this direction if maintainers decide compaction branch/restore plus narrower restart/snapshot issues are the only core-supported recovery surfaces.

recommendation.title: Define core contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and require a small design/API decision before implementation starts.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete supplied the current product-review context and is the clearest routing candidate in the issue discussion.
